_doc: Pinned upstream base models for the release (wd14-profile general tags). `active` names the base new releases are built on; switching it is a governed lifecycle step (docs/notes/tagger-base-switch-plan.md), never a hand edit to production. Files are pinned by sha256 of their bytes. `preprocessing` is the input contract the base is deployed and evaluated with: resize-totensor-unnormalized (today's release pipeline, which every logit patch was trained on) or wd-v3 (white alpha composite, white square pad, resize, normalise with the model's mean/std, RGB->BGR, as the WD v3 taggers are published).
